text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is here. Seiun Sky has made up her mind to participate, revealing she has a plan to break down the wall she's stuck behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When facing opponents who have already overcome their own limits, all she can do is the same, saying, "I have to overcome my limits and run away!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to smash down the wall between her and victory by pushing past her limits and maintaining top speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When facing opponents who have already overcome their own limits, all she can do is "pull ahead at the last possible second."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to smash down the wall between her and victory by conjuring a second wind at full speed in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When facing opponents who have already overcome their own limits, all she can do is "tear ahead at the hill."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to smash down the wall between her and victory through persistence and turning her perceived weakness into strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When facing opponents who have already overcome their own limits, all she can do is "pass 'em right back" the moment she's lost the lead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to smash down the wall between her and victory through stubborn willpower, even if she lacks talent and strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When facing opponents who have already overcome their own limits, all she can do is "aim for the best racer."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to smash down the wall between her and victory by toying with her target and breaking their momentum.
